label: D1 after a rare-rewarded a2 trial (S1 paid off) when the agent will stay with a2
explanation: Strong component: fires at D1 when the previous trial was a2 -> S1 (rare) and rewarded, i.e. the reward input is 1 after landing in S1 via a2, AND the agent goes on to choose a2 again (a model-free-like stay, against the model-based switch). This holds ~74% of activation mass with precision 0.85 on dev and covers ~91% of the top activation quartile. Without the upcoming-choice term (prev a2, rare, rewarded at D1) precision falls to 0.65 (F1 0.44): the unit is silent on those D1s when the agent switches to a1, so it tracks the agent own upcoming a2 commitment (a legitimate computed quantity; action at D1 is flagged FUTURE only because it is not yet emitted). Weak secondary component: low-magnitude (mostly <0.2 of max) activations at GO when choosing a2 after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward==0); adding it raises recall to 0.94 / mass 0.91 but precision drops to 0.36 (F1 0.52), so it was left out. Never fires at D2 or when the GO choice is a1; fires more mid-episode (trials 10-60) and when S2 is good.
